entries.meaningZh: 负担得起的；价格在经济承受范围内的
entries.en: The rent was affordable, but the flat was far from my workplace.
entries.zh: 房租我负担得起，但那套公寓离我的工作地点很远。

entries.en: The manager has discretionary authority to waive the fee in exceptional cases.
entries.zh: 经理有权在特殊情况下酌情免收这项费用。

entries.meaningZh: 下载〔把文件或程序从远端计算机传到本地〕
entries.en: Download the route map before you leave the hotel.
entries.zh: 离开酒店前下载好路线图。

entries.meaningZh: 好胜心；争强好胜的倾向
entries.en: Her competitiveness turned a friendly quiz into a serious contest.
entries.zh: 她的好胜心让一场友好的问答活动变成了认真的较量。

entries.meaningZh: 复兴；重振〔重新恢复活跃和重要地位〕
entries.en: New workshops and late-opening cafés contributed to the revitalization of the old harbour.
entries.zh: 新开设的工坊和营业至深夜的咖啡馆促进了老港区的复兴。
